what: A gun's smoke after the shot (release 2, behind the land battle's -TheaterLandBarrelSmoke; Brian, 26 November, 'do 2-11', item 7 of the film details). Laid over battle-fx.json for that battle alone (FBattleEffects::LayOver). after_wisp: after a tank gun, an anti-tank gun or a howitzer fires, once its smoke has rolled away (from_s), a thin wisp of the burnt charge curls from the bore for for_s more seconds, rising and leaning on the wind and thinning as the barrel cools; only within within_m of the eye, at most per_gun at once from one gun's place (same_gun_m) and most on the field, never past three fifths of the screen's room; its own dice from the place and the moment. steam.breech: a towed gun's or an open-topped gun's breech opening, a small puff of grey-brown powder smoke as the case comes out (the scene's Steam at case_clang, its own number). Colours written to land (tools/battle-fx/game_curve.py write): the wisp 139,141,144 lands 150,152,156 and old 154,156,158 lands 168,170,172; the breech puff 120,114,108 lands 120,112,102 and old 137,132,127 lands 146,140,132.
